name: (02) Thaumaturgy (Movement of the Mind) — 1 Basic — Force Bolt

system.description:
Concentrated will lashes out as an invisible jolt of motion, less a blow than a sudden shove that staggers foes and sends loose objects tumbling.

To strike a person, challenge your Mental Traits against the victim's Physical Traits; on a win they are knocked to the ground and lose their next action (not a full turn, so foes with Celerity may recover the same turn). You may instead lash an unheld object of up to a hundred pounds, pushing it about five feet in any direction; an object held by someone can only be knocked aside by winning the same Mental versus Physical Challenge, making this ideal for disarming foes at range. Retest with Occult.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
